body:
## Pull request overview

This PR standardizes the playground application's color scheme by replacing gradient colors (purple/indigo/pink) with Shadcn's semantic color tokens. The changes affect the visual styling across the playground's Home page, My Designs page, and Studio interface, removing hardcoded color gradients and colored shadows in favor of theme-aware semantic colors.

**Changes:**
- Removed 5 chart color CSS variables from the theme configuration (not currently in use)
- Replaced gradient backgrounds (`bg-gradient-to-r from-indigo-600 to-purple-600`) with semantic tokens (`bg-primary`)
- Replaced hardcoded text colors (`text-indigo-600`) with semantic equivalents (`text-primary`)
- Standardized button and UI element styling to use Shadcn's color system throughout

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 5 out of 5 changed files in this pull request and generated 5 comments.

<details>
<summary>Show a summary per file</summary>

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| apps/playground/src/index.css | Removed unused chart color variables and added whitespace for better readability |
| apps/playground/tailwind.config.js | Removed chart color definitions from Tailwind configuration |
| apps/playground/src/pages/Home.tsx | Replaced all gradient colors and hardcoded colors with semantic Shadcn tokens |
| apps/playground/src/pages/MyDesigns.tsx | Updated buttons and UI elements to use semantic color system |
| apps/playground/src/pages/Studio.tsx | Standardized toolbar, view switcher, and viewport controls with semantic colors |
</details>

The ternary operator returns identical styling for both the saved and unsaved states. The saved state should have distinct visual feedback, such as using a success-themed color (e.g., bg-accent or a green variant) to indicate successful save action. Currently both branches return 'bg-primary text-primary-foreground hover:bg-primary/90 shadow-lg'.

The ternary operator returns identical styling for both the copied and normal states. The copied state should have distinct visual feedback to indicate successful copy action, similar to the issue with the Save button. Currently both branches return 'bg-primary text-primary-foreground hover:bg-primary/90 shadow-lg'.

The inactive button hover state uses 'hover:bg-muted' while the parent container also uses 'bg-muted'. This causes the button to blend into the background on hover, reducing visibility. Consider using a different hover background like 'hover:bg-background' or 'hover:bg-card' for better visual feedback.
